summary: Steep cul-de-sac kerb with homes 12 m away on all sides.

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 12 m, 13 m and 16 m from the kerb, with more within 22 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Reachable and a couple of cars park nearby, but the kerb is over the slope limit.
drivers.convention: Residential cul-de-sac with a few parked cars; no signs.

sun_shade: Dense tree canopy on the south side of the kerb, open to the north.
